$comment: VAPP-122 app RECORDS ×4: an app's own data. A record = one JSON object (`data`) of a `kind` the app's manifest declares (`records: {<kind>: {schema}}`, the schema a JSON Schema subset the SDK validates: packages/exponential-ui host-router.json `records`), stored per TEAM under the app (`app_records`, one synced shape `app-records`, member-only, team-scoped, `deleted_at` + the `app_deleted_at` mirror = the static trash predicates: trash never reaches a client). READ = the binding `records:<kind>?…` (declared in `sources` as `records:*` or `records:<kind>`; there is no other spelling), which every app host resolves over the synced rows (web TanStack DB, desktop store, GRDB, Room) with eUI's ONE evaluator (VAPP-189: `@exponential_app/eui/host/query`, eui-core `host::query`, the Swift and Compose SDKs over the FFI; the grammar, the value and every case live in packages/exponential-ui fixtures/records-query.json; `mine`/`user=`/`author` read the AUTHOR `authorId ?? createdBy`; the `app=<slug>` rows = another app of the viewer's team, by slug). The `rowKeys` are RESERVED: a kind's schema may not declare them. WRITE = the host functions `records.upsert {kind, data, id?}` (create, or update = a shallow patch of `data` when `id` names the viewer's team's row AND the viewer may change it: `ownership`) and `records.delete {id}` (+ `records.batch`), NO consent card (an app's own rows; the package still lists them in `functions`), tRPC `apps.records.*` as the viewer; the server validates `data` against the kind's schema, caps it at contract `apps.recordMaxBytes` and the team's quota (plan-limits `appRecords`; over = the plan-limit error → a toast, feedback-states.json). MCP: the apps noun's `records_list {slug, kind?, limit?, offset?}`, `records_upsert {slug, kind, data, id?}`, `records_delete {slug, id}` (an agent fills an app's data). Copy ×4 = apps.json `copy.records*`. VAPP-159 SYNC: the web loads the shape ON DEMAND (#EXP-1380's rule for messages: TanStack DB `syncMode: on-demand`, the proxy forwards `subset__*` over the allowlisted columns): every read narrows by `app_id` (the hosting app, an `app=` app, the settings page count, the export), so a browser holds only the records of the apps it opened; desktop, iOS and Android keep the whole shape in their local store (offline, deltas only after the first sync), as they do for messages. PURGE: a deleted record (its own `deleted_at`) or a record of a trashed app (`app_deleted_at`; app trash has no restore) is HARD-deleted by the server once that stamp is older than `purge.retentionDays`, at most `purge.batch` rows per watchdog tick, oldest first (`purge.cases`: `deletedAt`/`appDeletedAt` as days before now, `purged` = due). VAPP-187 OWNERSHIP (`ownership`, spec docs/spec/apps.md §3.2/§3.4): a record carries `created_by` (who pressed the button, never changes), `author_id` (whose record it is: set to the writer on create, backfilled from `created_by`; a row without one reads `createdBy`) and `updated_by` (the last writer). The default policy `update: author`, `delete: author` = only the record's AUTHOR or a team OWNER may patch or delete it (`canChangeRecord(row, viewer, role, op)`, `canChangeCases`: role `owner` | `member` | null = not a member, never); every member may still create. The server enforces it in tRPC `apps.records.upsert` (with an id) / `.delete`, so the MCP `records_*` ops and the apps broker refuse the same way: FORBIDDEN `ownership.refusal` (a host write = the failed-action toast, feedback-states.json). The shape carries `author_id` + `updated_by`; every host, the Data tab and the `records:` value read the author. VAPP-188 ON-BEHALF (`onBehalf`, spec §3.2/§9.1/§10): a write may name its `author` (a user id): tRPC `apps.records.upsert {…, author?}`, the MCP `records_upsert {…, author?}`, an `.app.json` record's `author`. Only a team OWNER may write as someone else (`writeAsVerdict`, `writeAsCases`); `created_by`/`updated_by` stay the REAL writer, `author_id` = the named author; an owner's update may reassign it. AUDIT: a row whose `createdBy ≠ author` reads `dataTab.copy.byFor` ×4 (`recordByline`, `bylineCases`).

its app trashed 2 days ago stays

dataTab.$comment: VAPP-178 THE DATA TAB ×4 (apps.json `editorTabs`: web ≥ md + desktop the `data` tab, phones the third segment; testId apps.json `testIds.data`). It browses and edits the app's RECORDS of the HEAD package. KINDS = the head manifest's `records` keys sorted by name (`dataKinds`, `kindCases`), each with its live count (the synced rows of that app + kind, trash never reaches a client); none = the list-size EmptyState `copy.noKinds`. TOOLBAR: a Select (the existing one) whose options read `copy.kindOption` (`{kind} · {n}`), the first kind picked on open; at the end the `copy.addRecord` button (outline, `ui-add`; phones: the same button, compact). ROWS of the picked kind sorted `updatedAt` desc, ties by id (`dataRows`); none = the list-size EmptyState `copy.empty` under the toolbar. WIDE (web ≥ md + desktop): ONE grouped list (the Versions tab's group) used as a table: its first row = the HEADER (muted, text-xs): one cell per `dataColumns(schema)` (`columnCases`: the schema's `required` names in their order, then every other property sorted by name; a host's JSON layer may lose key order, so never the declaration order), then `copy.by` and `copy.updated`, then an empty menu cell; every row lays its cells on the SAME grid (a schema column of a fixed-width type takes `columns.typeWidths` px: a `date`/`time`/`date-time` string by its format, a number/integer/boolean by its type; every other column (text, enum, list) shares the rest equally (min `columns.minWidth` px); `by` and `updated` fixed `columns.byWidth`/`columns.updatedWidth` px, the menu `columns.menuWidth` px, `columns.gap` px between cells); a table wider than its pane SCROLLS SIDEWAYS (header and rows together), so the menu stays reachable, each cell one truncated line = `cellText` (`cellCases`: null/missing = empty, a boolean = `copy.yes`/`copy.no`, a number as written (`3`, `6.5`, never `3.0`), a list = its items joined `, `, an object = its JSON), `by` = the AUTHOR's name (`authorId ?? createdBy`, VAPP-187) (else `copy.byAgent` of apps.json), `updated` = the relative time; the trailing `…` (ghost icon button, `ui-more`) opens a menu `copy.edit` / `copy.delete` (destructive). PHONES: the same group without the header: a row = title `cellText` of the FIRST column (`copy.emptyTitle` when empty), subtitle (muted) = the other schema columns' non-empty cells joined ` · `, trailing the relative `updated` + the same `…` menu. ADD / EDIT = a FORM (web ≥ md + desktop: the existing Dialog; phones: a sheet) titled `copy.newTitle`/`copy.editTitle` (`{kind}`): one labelled field per `dataColumns` name (label = the name, `copy.optional` muted after an optional one), the control from `formFields` (`formCases`): `text` (a string; `placeholder` for a date/time/date-time format), `number` (number + integer), `switch` (boolean), `select` (a string enum: its values, an optional one adds `copy.none` first = null), `list` (an array: ONE text field, `copy.listHint` as its placeholder); edit pre-fills with `formInput` (a list joined `, `, a number as written, null = empty). SAVE (`copy.save`; `copy.cancel` closes) turns the inputs into data with `formData` (`parseCases`): empty text/number/select/list = null, a number field parses (anything unparsable stays the raw text so the server names it), a list splits on `,`, trims, drops empties and parses number/integer/boolean items; CREATE omits the nulls, EDIT keeps them (null clears an optional field, host-router.json `records`) and is a shallow patch of the row. Writes = tRPC `apps.records.upsert {id: appId, kind, data, recordId?}` / `apps.records.delete {id: appId, recordId}` as the viewer (no consent card: the app's own data). A refused write: BAD_REQUEST (the schema's issues) shows the server's message INLINE under the form (invalid input, feedback-states.json), anything else (the plan limit included) = the failed-action toast. DELETE asks first: the Prompt `copy.deleteTitle` / `copy.deleteBody` with `copy.delete` destructive. Every member may ADD; EDIT and DELETE follow `ownership` (VAPP-187): a row the viewer may not change (`canChangeRecord` false) keeps its `…` but DISABLED (the icon button's disabled state, the same ×4: no menu opens); a refused write (FORBIDDEN) = the failed-action toast. Model = `app-records.ts` (`dataKinds`, `dataColumns`, `dataRows`, `cellText`, `formFields`, `formInput`, `formData`); desktop `domain::app_records`, iOS `AppRecords.swift`, Android `AppRecords.kt` replay every `*Cases` here. VAPP-188 ON-BEHALF: `by` = `recordByline` (`bylineCases`): the author's name (else `copy.byAgent` of apps.json = the case's `fallback`), and when the row's writer (`createdBy`) is someone ELSE than its author and still has a name, `copy.byFor` (`{writer} for {author}`). For a team OWNER only, the form's FIRST field is `copy.author`: the existing form Select (the same control as a `select` field, required) of the team's members by name (`authorOptions`, `authorOptionCases`: case-insensitive, ties by id), defaulting to the record's author on edit and the viewer on create (`formAuthor.default`); Save sends `author` only when the pick differs from that base (`formAuthor.send`, null = omit; `formAuthorCases`). Non-owners see no picker and never send `author`. A refused on-behalf write (FORBIDDEN) = the failed-action toast; `notMember` (BAD_REQUEST) shows inline like a schema issue.

ownership.$comment: VAPP-187: who may patch or delete a record. `author` = the row's `authorId ?? createdBy`. Policy `author` = the author or a team owner; `member` = any member (the future per-kind policy, spec §3.4; no kind sets it yet). `role` null = the viewer is not a member of the record's team: never. A viewer null (signed out): never. A row with no author at all (its writer's account is gone) is an owner's only. Clients disable the Data tab's row menu (`dataTab`) when neither op is allowed; the server answers FORBIDDEN with `refusal`.
ownership.refusal: Only the record's author or a team owner can change it

onBehalf.$comment: VAPP-188: who may set a record's `author` to someone else. `author` absent/null = the writer (no on-behalf write). The writer themself = always fine (a member writes as themself). Anyone else = a team OWNER only (`forbidden` otherwise: FORBIDDEN `refusal`), and the author must be a MEMBER of the record's team (`notMember`: BAD_REQUEST `notMember`; checked after the role, so a non-owner never learns who is a member). `role` null = the viewer is not a member: `forbidden`. On an UPDATE the row's change rule (`ownership`) runs first; `author` then REASSIGNS the row (owners only, the same verdict). `created_by` never changes, `updated_by` = the real writer. IMPORT (`importAuthor`, `importCases`; the `.app.json` record's optional `author`, app-export.json): absent, the importer, or not a member of the importing team = the IMPORTER (a file from another team keeps its rows, as the importer's); another member = that member when the importer is an OWNER, else the IMPORTER too (VAPP-192: exports now carry every record's author, so a member importing a teammate's export keeps the rows as their own instead of being refused).
onBehalf.refusal: Only a team owner can write for another member
onBehalf.notMember: The author must be a member of the team
